name: Wonderla Holidays Ltd
title: Wonderla Holidays Ltd - 538268 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Amusement-park operator with no new park capex in FY27 (only INR35-40 crore sustaining capex) and a 5-park base; Q4 volume growth came from Chennai, while Hyderabad footfall fell 7% in FY26 and Q1 is only "pretty okay".

utilisation.quote: we are not planning any large capex in this financial year. There could be certain sustaining capex, about some INR35 crores to INR40 crores in the financial year.

capex.quote: we are not planning any large capex in this financial year. There could be certain sustaining capex, about some INR35 crores to INR40 crores in the financial year.

triggers.label: No large capex in FY27
triggers.quote: we are not planning any large capex in this financial year

triggers.label: Hyderabad FY26 footfall down 7%
triggers.quote: in a mature park like Hyderabad, overall for FY '26, the footfalls were down by 7% year-on-year

triggers.label: Q1 flattish at some parks
triggers.quote: some are doing well, some are flattish

guidance.quote: There could be certain sustaining capex, about some INR35 crores to INR40 crores in the financial year.

guidance.metric: Resort ADR uplift post Bangalore refurbishment
guidance.quote: We expect about a 7% to 12% increase in ADR after refurbishment.
Are we going to maintain the A&P spend at 7% to 8% on the top line?
On a yearly basis, it can touch about INR45 crores to INR50 crores in the financial year FY 2027.
our first milestone is can we get to around 2.5 lakhs footfall in the coming financial year.

red_flags.label: Hyderabad footfall decline two years running
red_flags.quote: we have degrown for the second consecutive year

red_flags.label: Tier-1 land deals slipping, no new park closed
red_flags.quote: We are already looking at expanding to other cities, like I've said before, but it just takes time

evasions.quote: We don't know EBITDA. 30% is the EBITDA margin for the last quarter.
we would always hesitate giving forward-looking thing on like especially footfall.
Hard to say. I mean there's a lot of uncertainty in the market
